Animals that are so few that they are at risk of extinction are called endangered animals.
There are many reasons: habitat loss, pollution, hunting, fishing, disease and a low birth rate.
Tigers have long been hunted for their beautifully patterned fur. They are also dying because of habitat loss.
Sea turtles are killed for their eggs, meat, skin and shells. They also suffer from overexploitation and poaching.
Amur leopards are hunted for their beautiful fur. Now, fewer than 60 Amur leopards are left.
There are only about 200 to 300 Cross River gorillas and about 900 mountain gorillas left.
Rhinos are endangered because of poaching for their horns. Disease and natural disasters also threaten them.
There are more than 1,000 Amur leopards.
Orangutans, Sumatran elephants, pangolins, pandas and vaquitas are endangered, too. Which one do you know?
